name: Caprese (Mozzarella, Tomato, Pesto) Crostini Bento Box with Chocolate Pudding, Banana & Carrots

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash, dry, peel, and trim carrot. Quarter lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2-inch long sticks. Place in the first small compartment of the bento box.
Place (unpeeled) banana in the second small compartment of the bento box.
Wash, dry, and slice tomato crosswise into 1/4-inch rounds. Place tomato and mozzarella in the medium compartment of the bento box, alternating slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ Roma tomato
3 oz fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place pesto in a small container with a lid. Place pesto, pudding, and crostini in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp basil pesto
1 (3.6 oz) cup chocolate pudding snack
½ cup crostini-style crackers

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
